english.title: Occupier of dam / fish pass fail to make / maintain it
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in any waters frequented by salmon or migratory trout, the occupier for the time being of

(A)_[a new dam which was constructed so as to create increased obstruction to the passage of salmon or migratory trout]_
(B)_[an existing dam which was raised or otherwise altered so as to create increased obstruction to the passage of salmon or migratory trout]_
(C)_[an obstruction to the passage of salmon or migratory trout which was created, increased or caused]_

and being required by the appropriate agency to make a fish pass for salmon or migratory trout of such form or dimensions as the appropriate agency may approve as part of the structure of, or in connection with

(D)_[the dam]_
(E)_[an obstruction]_

and thereafter maintain it in an efficient state, failed to

(F)_[make such a fish pass.]_
(G)_[maintain such a fish pass in an efficient state]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1)(a) and (2) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
